hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is obtained from the latent function F=f by divided-difference operators: G0001 is the first Newton divided difference (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y); G0002 is the confluent repeated-node Hermite divided difference at (x,x), identified with the derivative F'(x) under the standard derivative identification.
required_assumptions: df(x) is the derivative of f at x

proof_obligations.expected: G0002 == F^{1}(x) at repeated nodes (x,x) with F=f

hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The expressions are structurally a first divided difference of f and its derivative evaluation df(x). This is a standard confluent divided-difference relation: the first divided difference tends to the derivative when the two sample points coalesce.
